options.query_instruction: Given a short concept extracted from a Chinese literary quotation, retrieve the literary theme concepts whose meanings match the concept.

notes: Route 2: generate up to five ephemeral concepts from the quote, then map them to the current Theme library using Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B cosine similarity.
Generated concepts are intermediate evidence only and are never inserted into the Theme library.
Theme document representation is fixed to canonical label + definition + aliases.
The first quote's generation call is measured as route model preparation and reused in its result.
